author: GucciAviator32
body:
Hello Avicus Staff,
I am asking for a ban appeal for the ban I received on February 19, 2016. I am to this day, not sure why I got banned because it said advertising even though I don't have my own server, and I wouldn't advertise for any other server. This ban has really annoyed me ever since the day of. I'd greatly appreciate it if you'd unban me.

Thank You, 
cpdhockey1
